parsed.rationale: All five members — AppleMusicService, BandcampService, SoundCloudService, SpotifyService, and YouTubeMusicService — are classified as `type-alias-object` at the same structural shape (shared_field_count: 1, no differing_slots) within the same package `MusicShareKit`, all at line 13 of their respective files. This strongly suggests each is a thin type alias or trivially-shaped wrapper over a common underlying type, with no meaningful per-service differentiation captured in the type system. Introducing a `MusicService` protocol (potentially a PAT if service-specific configuration types differ) would let each service conform rather than duplicate the same structural shell, enabling polymorphic handling across all five services. None of the records carry test, codegen, mock, or sample-app flags, so this is live production code where the duplication carries real maintenance cost.
